source_definition.description: Applies a 1D adaptive average pooling.
source_definition.math_symbol:
Sum(
  Piecewise(
    (X[n, c, k], 
     (k >= floor(w * Dim(X, 2) / W_out)) & 
     (k < ceiling((w + 1) * Dim(X, 2) / W_out))),
    (0, True)

) / (ceiling((w + 1) * Dim(X, 2) / W_out) - floor(w * Dim(X, 2) / W_out))

target_definition.description: Adaptive 1D average pooling. Calculates dynamic window: [start, end).

) / (ceiling((i + 1) * Dim(X, 2) / output_size) - floor(i * Dim(X, 2) / output_size))

source_definition.description: Applies a 2D adaptive average pooling.
source_definition.math_symbol:
Sum(
  Sum(
    Piecewise(
      (X[n, c, kh, kw],
       (kh >= floor(h * Dim(X, 2) / H_out)) & 
       (kh < ceiling((h + 1) * Dim(X, 2) / H_out)) &
       (kw >= floor(w * Dim(X, 3) / W_out)) & 
       (kw < ceiling((w + 1) * Dim(X, 3) / W_out))),
      (0, True)
    ),
    (kw, 0, Dim(X, 3) - 1)
  ),
  (kh, 0, Dim(X, 2) - 1)
) / (
  (ceiling((h + 1) * Dim(X, 2) / H_out) - floor(h * Dim(X, 2) / H_out)) * (ceiling((w + 1) * Dim(X, 3) / W_out) - floor(w * Dim(X, 3) / W_out))
)

target_definition.description: Adaptive 2D average pooling over NCHW layout.
target_definition.math_symbol:

  X[n, c, h, w],
  (h, floor(i * Dim(X, 2) / H_out), ceiling((i + 1) * Dim(X, 2) / H_out) - 1),
  (w, floor(j * Dim(X, 3) / W_out), ceiling((j + 1) * Dim(X, 3) / W_out) - 1)
) / (
  (ceiling((i + 1) * Dim(X, 2) / H_out) - floor(i * Dim(X, 2) / H_out)) *
  (ceiling((j + 1) * Dim(X, 3) / W_out) - floor(j * Dim(X, 3) / W_out))

records.title: AvgPool1d
records.source: SemTrans-JIT / PyTorch 与 Paddle 数学定义

source_definition.description: 1D Average Pooling. Divisor logic strictly handles ceil_mode out-of-bounds.
source_definition.math_symbol:
Sum(
  Piecewise(
    (X[n, c, Strd * w + m - P], (Strd * w + m - P >= 0) & (Strd * w + m - P < Dim(X, 2))),
    (0, True)
  ),
  (m, 0, K - 1)
) / Max(
  Sum(
    Piecewise(
      (1, (Strd * w + m - P >= 0) & (Strd * w + m - P < Dim(X, 2))),
      (Piecewise((1, count_include_pad), (0, True)), (Strd * w + m - P >= -P) & (Strd * w + m - P < Dim(X, 2) + P)),
      (0, True)
    ),
    (m, 0, K - 1)
  ),
  1
)
output_shape: Piecewise( (ceiling((Dim(X, 2) + 2 * P - K) / Strd + 1), ceil_mode), (floor((Dim(X, 2) + 2 * P - K) / Strd + 1), True) )

target_definition.description: Paddle 2D Average Pooling.
target_definition.math_symbol:
Sum(
  Sum(
    Piecewise(
      (X[n, c, i * S_h + m - P_h, j * S_w + l - P_w], 
       (i * S_h + m - P_h >= 0) & (i * S_h + m - P_h < Dim(X, 2)) &
       (j * S_w + l - P_w >= 0) & (j * S_w + l - P_w < Dim(X, 3))),
      (0, True)
    ),
    (l, 0, K_w - 1)
  ),
  (m, 0, K_h - 1)
) / Piecewise(
  (safe_divisor, safe_divisor > 0),
  (
    Piecewise(
      (
        Sum(
          Sum(
            Piecewise(
              (1, 
               (i * S_h + m - P_h >= 0) & (i * S_h + m - P_h < Dim(X, 2)) &
               (j * S_w + l - P_w >= 0) & (j * S_w + l - P_w < Dim(X, 3))),
              (0, True)
            ),
            (l, 0, K_w - 1)
          ),
          (m, 0, K_h - 1)
        ), 
        exclusive
      ),
      (
        Min(K_h, Dim(X, 2) + 2*P_h - i*S_h) * Min(K_w, Dim(X, 3) + 2*P_w - j*S_w),
        True
      )
    ),
    True
  )
)
output_shape: Piecewise((ceiling((Dim(X, 2) + 2*P_h - K_h) / S_h) + 1, ceil_mode), (floor((Dim(X, 2) + 2*P_h - K_h) / S_h) + 1, True))

records.source: SemTrans-JIT / PyTorch 与 Paddle 数学定义

source_definition.description: 3D Average Pooling with robust dynamic divisor and ceil_mode alignment.
source_definition.math_symbol:
Sum(Sum(Sum(
  Piecewise(
    (X[n, c, S_d * d + kd - P_d, S_h * h + kh - P_h, S_w * w + kw - P_w], 
     (S_d * d + kd - P_d >= 0) & (S_d * d + kd - P_d < Dim(X, 2)) &
     (S_h * h + kh - P_h >= 0) & (S_h * h + kh - P_h < Dim(X, 3)) &
     (S_w * w + kw - P_w >= 0) & (S_w * w + kw - P_w < Dim(X, 4))),
    (0, True)
  ),
  (kw, 0, K_w - 1)), (kh, 0, K_h - 1)), (kd, 0, K_d - 1)
) / Piecewise(
  (Max(safe_div, 1), safe_div > 0),
  (Max(
    Sum(Sum(Sum(
      Piecewise(
        (1, (S_d * d + kd - P_d >= 0) & (S_d * d + kd - P_d < Dim(X, 2)) &
            (S_h * h + kh - P_h >= 0) & (S_h * h + kh - P_h < Dim(X, 3)) &
            (S_w * w + kw - P_w >= 0) & (S_w * w + kw - P_w < Dim(X, 4))),
        (Piecewise((1, count_include_pad), (0, True)), 
            (S_d * d + kd - P_d >= -P_d) & (S_d * d + kd - P_d < Dim(X, 2) + P_d) &
            (S_h * h + kh - P_h >= -P_h) & (S_h * h + kh - P_h < Dim(X, 3) + P_h) &
            (S_w * w + kw - P_w >= -P_w) & (S_w * w + kw - P_w < Dim(X, 4) + P_w)),
        (0, True)
      ),
      (kw, 0, K_w - 1)), (kh, 0, K_h - 1)), (kd, 0, K_d - 1)
    ), 1), True)
)
output_shape: Piecewise((ceiling((Dim(X, 2) + 2 * P_d - K_d) / S_d + 1), ceil_mode), (floor((Dim(X, 2) + 2 * P_d - K_d) / S_d + 1), True))
Piecewise((ceiling((Dim(X, 3) + 2 * P_h - K_h) / S_h + 1), ceil_mode), (floor((Dim(X, 3) + 2 * P_h - K_h) / S_h + 1), True))
Piecewise((ceiling((Dim(X, 4) + 2 * P_w - K_w) / S_w + 1), ceil_mode), (floor((Dim(X, 4) + 2 * P_w - K_w) / S_w + 1), True))

target_definition.description: Paddle 3D Average Pooling.
target_definition.math_symbol:
Sum(
  Sum(
    Sum(
      Piecewise(
        (X[n, c, i * S_d + k_d - P_d, j * S_h + m - P_h, k * S_w + l - P_w], 
         (i * S_d + k_d - P_d >= 0) & (i * S_d + k_d - P_d < Dim(X, 2)) &
         (j * S_h + m - P_h >= 0) & (j * S_h + m - P_h < Dim(X, 3)) &

        (0, True)
      ),
      (l, 0, K_w - 1)
    ),
    (m, 0, K_h - 1)
  ),
  (k_d, 0, K_d - 1)
) / Piecewise(
  (safe_divisor, safe_divisor > 0),
  (
    Piecewise(
      (
        Sum(
          Sum(
            Sum(
              Piecewise(
                (1, 
                 (i * S_d + k_d - P_d >= 0) & (i * S_d + k_d - P_d < Dim(X, 2)) &
                 (j * S_h + m - P_h >= 0) & (j * S_h + m - P_h < Dim(X, 3)) &
                 (k * S_w + l - P_w >= 0) & (k * S_w + l - P_w < Dim(X, 4))),
                (0, True)

              (l, 0, K_w - 1)
            ),
            (m, 0, K_h - 1)
          ),
          (k_d, 0, K_d - 1)
        ),

        True
      )
    ),
    True
  )
)

    Sum(Sum(W[out, k1, k2] * X1[n, k1] * X2[n, k2], (k1, 0, cin1 - 1)), (k2, 0, cin2 - 1)) + B[out], 
    (Rank(X1) == 2) & bias
